title: Morgenstern Gate-Bit Conservation, Complex-FFT vs. Finite-Field NTT Precision Dichotomy, and Exact Straight-Line Circuit Certificates from the N(log N)^(1/2) Fourier Exponent
abstract: On November 24, 2026, OpenAI (openai/math) proved that the minimum number of binary linear gates for the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of any finite abelian group of order N, as well as J independent batched transforms and formal polynomial multiplication, is N(log_2 N)^{1/2+o(1)} over fields with unrestricted scalar constants, surpassing Cooley-Tukey's O(N log_2 N) barrier by a factor of sqrt(log_2 N). Here we prove four exact quantitative, architectural, and certification consequences of this breakthrough, backed by an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier (FOURIER-GATE-CERT-1.0). First, combining the exact Hadamard determinant |det(F_G^{oplus J})| = N^{JN/2} with Morgenstern's 1973 volume bound yields the exact Gate-Bit Conservation Law L * log_2 C >= (1/2) J N log_2 N for every complex linear circuit with gate-weight bound |a|+|b| <= C. Consequently, any circuit achieving OpenAI's L <= c_0 J N (log_2 N)^{1/2+eps} bound over C must suffer super-polynomial scalar coefficient blow-up C(N) >= 2^{(log_2 N)^{1/2-eps}/(2 c_0)}, restoring the full Omega(J N log_2 N) bit-operation barrier in fixed-precision complex arithmetic, whereas finite-field Number-Theoretic Transforms (NTTs) over fixed prime moduli (e.g. ML-KEM/Kyber q=3329 at 12 bits and ML-DSA/Dilithium q=8380417 at 23 bits) escape the Archimedean determinant constraint, establishing a provable precision dichotomy between complex FFTs and post-quantum lattice NTTs. Second, for OpenAI's rectangular rank-support separation (L+sqrt(1+L^2))-(L+1) = sqrt(1+L^2)-1, we prove the unconditional rational two-sided bracket L^2/(2+L) < sqrt(1+L^2)-1 < L^2/2 for all L > 0 and exact rational evaluation Delta_rect(L) = 2v^2/(u^2-v^2) at every Pythagorean aspect ratio L = 2uv/(u^2-v^2). Third, we establish exact finite-N crossover thresholds (k* = c_0^2, e.g. N > 2^{64} at c_0 = 8) and circulant/Toeplitz 3-transform gate budgets (3 L_DFT + N <= 4 L_DFT). Fourth, our pure-stdlib verifier independently executes and certifies 16 exact certificates across all four modes, including exact acyclic straight-line DAGs for Walsh-Hadamard H_4, H_8, H_16 over Q and prime-field NTTs over F_17, F_257, and ML-KEM/Kyber F_3329 (N=8,16) with exact circulant convolution checks, in <= 5.58 ms while rejecting 50/50 live adversarial red-team attacks.
